name: record_verification
description: Record the outcome of this invoice verification call: whether the issuer confirmed the invoice is correct and genuine, or denied it / flagged a detail as wrong. Call this exactly once, after you have an explicit confirm-or-deny answer from the person you are speaking with.

request_body_schema.description: Request body for the record_verification webhook

invoice_id.description: The invoice_id being verified on this call, from the call's own dynamic variables context.

outcome.description: 'confirmed' if the issuer verified the invoice is correct and genuine, 'denied' if they said any detail is wrong or that they did not issue it.

evidence.description: Short factual summary of what the person said, quoting the specific disputed detail if there was one.
